title: MaleTheme Solo #002 · 남 V자 보디빌더·에메랄드 라인·산타 테마·메탈릭
prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 2:3 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a vast white salt flat reflecting the sky with a smooth flat floor and a standard-height wooden doorway frame standing at his side, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, completely empty of other people, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as him, NO dark background NO black void, ONE person standing, sharp focus from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in natural sunlight, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

SUBJECT: ONE real adult Filipino man in his early 20s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a fresh-faced boy-group idol face with clear glowing skin, bright eyes and a gentle smile line, clean-shaven, bold emerald-green eyeliner with a sheer burgundy-stained lip, smooth warm tan skin, a cool composed look, bold vivid electric-blue hair styled in a layered wolf cut with curtain bangs, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a large gold hoop carrying two heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on gold chains of different lengths (a tin ship's anchor, a gold hammer head), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and on the other ear a large brass hoop carrying six heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on brass chains of different lengths (an iron teardrop-shaped sinker, an iron small flared temple bell, a gold barrel-shaped weight, a tin pyramid-shaped lump, a lead cube-shaped block, an iron chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and seven to ten heavily stacked rose-gold anklets. Extremely long stiletto nails, holographic finish studded with crystals.
SUBJECT Physique: An extraordinarily large and powerful man, far beyond any real person. A massive V-shaped torso: enormously broad shoulders with capped, rounded deltoids, a thick heavy chest, a deeply carved six-pack abdomen narrowing to a comparatively small waist, huge thick arms with split biceps and horseshoe triceps, wide flaring lats, and powerful thick quads and diamond calves. His head stays in correct proportion to his broad frame. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
SUBJECT Outfit: His skin is bare and unpainted, wearing a red velvet Santa hat with a white fur trim and pom-pom, white fur cuffs on both wrists, and a minimal mirror-polished metallic red velvet with mirror-polished metallic white fur trim T-back thong with one tiny opaque front panel on thin side strings tied high at the hips and a single thin strap down the back, the small opaque piece fully covering him, his chest and stomach bare.
SUBJECT Pose: square to camera, feet wide, arms clear of his body.
SUBJECT Footwear: Extreme hot-pink platform stiletto cross-strap sandals, the platform soles rising far higher than his ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each material catching the sunlight in sharp glints, the sunlight carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 2:3 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, the face toward the camera.
